results.text: Investigation of Severe Hypoglycemia Risk Among Patients with Diabetes Treated with Ultra-Rapid Lispro in Japan. There is no information on the incidence of severe hypoglycemia in real-world patients with diabetes receiving ultra-rapid lispro (URLi). This post-marketing, observational, safety study assessed the incidence proportion and incidence rate of the first severe hypoglycemia event requiring a hospital visit in URLi-treated patients. Insulinoma Mimic: Tramadol-induced Hypoglycemia. Endogenous hyperinsulinemia hypoglycemia has numerous etiologies. The objective of this report is to describe a patient with severe hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia with no known history of diabetes or hypoglycemia who presented with acute altered mental status. Blood glucose was noted to be 40 mg/dL (2.22 mmol/L) (reference range 65-125 mg/dL; 3.61-6.94 mmol/L). The patient's sulfonylurea screen was negative.
